title: The lookup of a booking's room moves into one helper, roomOf, which refuses an unknown room with an Error, not a RangeError: it is not a value out of bounds. The @throws line on the handle is forgotten
covers: a stated function calls a private helper that throws an unstated kind
rule 46 reads only the function's own throw statements
the kind stated on the handle is unchanged
note: bookings' own tests pass (the unknown-room test now matches the message). billing's Z06b test expects bookings' RangeError for an estimate of an unknown room and gets an Error: it fails. Nothing exported changes, so bookings' listing is the same and nobody is told.
